'''Thew Marstan''' was a strongman working with [[Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium]]. Although he stood less than one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall, he was immensely strong, able to bend metal bars into a knot and lift a platform laden with audience members above his head. No explanation for his strength was given, and he refused to talk about it.
